proposal.summary: An issue in GitLab EE allows external users with owner roles to escalate privileges by creating service accounts that can access internal projects.
proposal.cwe_quote: The external user may escalate their privileges on the instance by creating a service account in that group.

AV.quote: If an external user is given an owner role on any group...
